description: Source code for handling fatal errors and exceptions in Zephyr OS on x86 architecture, including functions for system halt, stack checking, exception handling, and page fault management.

methods.name: arch_system_halt
methods.description: Halts the system and causes QEMU to exit with a specific reason code.

methods.name: z_x86_check_stack_bounds
methods.description: Checks if a given address and size are within the current thread or interrupt stack bounds.

methods.name: z_x86_fatal_error
methods.description: Handles fatal errors by dumping register states and halting execution.

methods.name: z_x86_unhandled_cpu_exception
methods.description: Handles unhandled CPU exceptions, logs details, and triggers fatal error.

methods.name: z_x86_page_fault_handler
methods.description: Handles page faults, checks for demand paging, and manages user space exceptions.

methods.name: z_x86_do_kernel_oops
methods.description: Handles kernel oops scenarios, retrieves reason code, and triggers fatal error.
